4050-4419-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4050-4419-4694-7306.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Repeat from step 1.

4484-6440-8095.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
4484-6440-8095.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Ebondeath.
Repeat.

301-2376-7859.description:
Activate Goblin Chirurgeon by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Rhythm of the Wild.
Resolve the Goblin Chirurgeon ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1991-3259-6791.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1991-3259-6791.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tana, triggering Breath of Fury and Tana.
Resolve the Tana trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

394-3240-5256-6462.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1496-3197-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1496-3197-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

80-216-1618-2440.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Metallurgic Summonings
80-216-1618-2440.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Venture Forth.
Venture Forth triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Metallurgic Summonings triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Venture Forth.
Repeat.
80-216-1618-2440.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Metallurgic Summonings. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

3536-5078-6650.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic and The Lunar Whale as attackers. When Cheering Fanatic triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3490-4017-4659-4716.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4017-4659-4716.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

3375-3532-5078-6769.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two counters on creatures you control.
3375-3532-5078-6769.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Surge Conductor triggers, putting a counter on a creature you control that already has a counter on it.
Repeat.

3054-4050-5075.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
3054-4050-5075.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Ogre Slumlord triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

841-4544-5686--106.notablePrerequisites:
You don't control a Ring-bearer.
You have a land card in hand.
841-4544-5686--106.description:
Play a land card.
Dúnedain Rangers and the permanent with a Landfall ability trigger.
Resolve the permanent with a Landfall ability trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Dúnedain Rangers trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, and causing the creature token to become your Ring-bearer.
Sméagol triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
Resolve the Sméagol trigger, causing an opponent to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then causing you to put the land onto the battlefield tapped under your control, and your opponent to put all other revealed cards into their graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
841-4544-5686--106.notes: This combo can be stopped if an opponent runs out of lands in their library, so it is recommended to alternate opponents in between cycles to maximize the amount of iterations.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2092-3719-4753-5326.notablePrerequisites: Clever Impersonator and Agatha of the Vile Cauldron each have a power of at least 2.
2092-3719-4753-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Clever Impersonator and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Clever Impersonator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Clever Impersonator to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Clever Impersonator enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Clever Impersonator by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1414-1482-5660-5943.notablePrerequisites: One of the self-sacrificing artifacts must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
1414-1482-5660-5943.description:
Cast the self-sacrificing artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Ms. Bumbleflower triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the self-sacrificing artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the self-sacrificing artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it, and paying other costs if necessary.
Repeat.

2-2557-4659-5554.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Gnomes, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

4871-5147-5433.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure.
4871-5147-5433.description:
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Krenko triggers, causing you to pay {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token with haste.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Goblin token.
When the Goblin dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1418-1737-3094-4636.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {6} and tapping it.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Prototype Portal's ability.
Resolve the copy of Prototype Portal's ability, creating a token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart.
When the Gonti's Aether Heart token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Resolve the original Prototype Portal ability, creating a token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart.
Put either Gonti's Aether Heart token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Gonti's Aether Heart token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Activate the remaining Gonti's Aether Heart token by paying eight {E} and exiling it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

939-2557-4404-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Soul Foundry by paying {2} and tapping it, creating two token copies of Corridor Monitor.
When the Corridor Monitor tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, untapping Soul Foundry and Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

719-1379-1558-4338.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five other creatures.
"Cleric" chosen with Xenograft.
719-1379-1558-4338.description:
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five other creatures.
When the creatures die as Clerics due to Xenograft, Rotlung Reanimator triggers five times, creating five 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

565-1954-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{W}.
565-1954-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{W}.
Cast Change of Heart with buyback by paying {3}{W}, targeting Peregrine Drake.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake.
The Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve Change of Heart, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{W}, this combo nets infinite mana, which you can then target any creatures you control in step 2 to create infinite token copies of them.

2198-4249-4499.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six devotion to any color.
2198-4249-4499.description:
Activate Nykthos' second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least six mana of any color.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, untapping Deceiver Exarch.
When Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Nykthos.
Repeat.

618-2178-5147.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Kiki-Jiki.
You control at least one nonlegendary creature.
618-2178-5147.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary creature you control with haste.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
The token dies, triggering Kiki-Jiki, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1479-2783-3257.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2783-3257.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Nesting Dragon, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2104-4305-4477.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Greenwarden of Murasa.
2104-4305-4477.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a copy of Greenwarden of Murasa.
Greenwarden of Murasa enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation to your hand.
Repeat.

240-1636-2034.notablePrerequisites: Atla does not have summoning sickness.
240-1636-2034.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a 0/1 Egg creature token.
The Egg enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Egg, adding {C}{C}.
The Egg dies, triggering Atla, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card, then put the creature card onto the battlefield and all other revealed cards on the bottom of your library.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
